title: CTGAN–GNN–TCN Fraud Detection (Reproducible Repo Scaffold)
summary: A reproducible, leakage-safe fraud detection pipeline for the IEEE-CIS dataset that combines CTGAN-based minority-class augmentation with a heterogeneous GNN and TCN model. It trains an SDV CTGANSynthesizer on the training split to generate and structure-align synthetic fraud transactions for class-imbalance augmentation.
evidence: src/synth/ctgan_train.py:5-9,27-44 imports CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata from sdv, trains and saves/loads the model
